story: Main student dashboard: questionnaires -> explicit browser DistilBERT -> student-confirmed concerns -> adaptive question bank -> explained symptom ranges -> authenticated demo directory and community filters.

regression.note: Full 746-test regression passed. Final removal of misleading model-priority wording was followed by 24 passing support/matching tests.

staticChecks.eslint: passed for all changed concern/main-flow files

questionPath: If you checked off any problems, how difficult have these problems made it for you to do your work, take care of things at home, or get along with other people?
How long have the concerns you want to discuss been affecting you?
What would feel most useful to you today?
How are your current concerns affecting your study routine?
What would you most like help with around sleep?
Which area is most connected to your worry right now?
mainFlow.explanation:
How your answers led to this summary
PHQ-9: 12/27, in the moderate symptom range. This comes from your questionnaire answers.
GAD-7: 11/21, in the moderate symptom range. This comes from your questionnaire answers.
You confirmed these support topics: study & exam pressure, sleep & routines, worry & anxiety. DistilBERT supplied tentative topic scores; your choices determined which topics were used.
Daily-life impact you reported: very difficult.
Duration you reported: more than a month.
Your preferred next step: talk to a professional.
For worry & anxiety, you selected: study or exams.
For sleep & routines, you selected: getting to sleep.
For study & exam pressure, you selected: starting tasks is difficult.

Text model: c2-distilbert-concerns-v1. Questionnaire ranges come from standard calculations; support suggestions also use your reported impact and preferences.

Why these follow-up questions?

newTextSecretPatternScan.scope: New text files only; not a comprehensive security audit

limits: Local development verification only; no production build, deployment, commit or push performed.
English synthetic-data concern pilot; no clinical, cultural or real student validation.
Substantial training/validation overfitting and known negation/third-person failures are recorded in the guide and challenge report.
Browser inference requires local ignored FP32 assets, about 268 MB; another host must provision the verified artifacts.
Professional ranking includes application policy and preference filters; it is not a learned prediction of treatment outcomes.
Desktop dashboard was verified; no mobile-device or production compatibility claim.
